WITH org00 AS ( SELECT org01_code_id AS org00_org_code_id , org01_company_id AS org00_company_id , org01_org_cd AS org00_org_cd , org01_open_date AS org00_open_date , org01_close_date AS org00_close_date , org01_open_reason AS org00_open_reason , org01_close_reason AS org00_close_reason , org02_info_id AS org00_org_info_id , org02_kor_nm AS org00_kor_nm , org02_mod_date AS org00_mod_date , org02_mod_reason AS org00_mod_reason , org02_parent_code_id AS org00_parent_code_id , org02_inner_type AS org00_inner_type , org02_eng_nm AS org00_eng_nm , org02_note AS org00_note , org02_level_cd AS org00_level_cd , org02_sort_order AS org00_seq , org02_mod_detail AS org00_mod_detail , org02_dcr_id_word AS org00_dcr_id_word
, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(org01_org_cd,1,2) = '11' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS org00_ignore_stamp FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND org01_company_id = #{companyId} ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (ics31_person_id) emp01_person_id AS person_id , f_org_parent_full_nm(emp03_org_code_id, #{stdDate}) AS org_name , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd, emp01_company_id, #{stdDate}) AS title_name , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , emp01_kor_nm AS person_name , emp03_trans_date AS trans_date FROM ics31_compliance_write INNER JOIN ics30_compliance ON ( ics30_compliance_id = ics31_compliance_id AND ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_company_id = ics31_company_id AND ics30_start_date <= #{stdDate} AND COALESCE(ics30_date_fix_yn,'false') = 'true') AND #{stdDate} <= COALESCE(ics30_use_close_date, '2999-12-31'::date) ) INNER JOIN emp01_person emp01 ON emp01.emp01_person_id = ics31_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp02_others emp02 ON emp01_person_id = emp02_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans emp03 ON emp03.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE ics31_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics31_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date,'YYYY.MM') AND ics31_cycle_type = #{cycleType} AND COALESCE(ics31_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' AND ics31_confirmer_id = #{confirmerId} AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01.emp01_person_id AND ( (x.emp03_trans_cd = '900' AND x.emp03_trans_date < #{stdDate}::date) OR (x.emp03_trans_cd != '900' AND x.emp03_trans_date <= #{stdDate}::date))) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_org_parent_full_nm(emp03_org_code_id, #{stdDate}), emp01_kor_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
